values.note: Cottonwood Campground, loops A-F. CPW's booking site lists 200 campsites (152 electric + 4 electric ADA, 42 full hookup + 2 full-hookup ADA; 124 pull-through, 74 back-in); the park's camping page still says '140 paved pull-through sites, equipped for vehicles up to 40 feet'. Per-site lengths on the booking site: 60 ft (loops B-F pull-throughs), 40 and 55 ft (loop A). Two sleeping units (one hard-sided) and six people per site; all vehicles and trailers must stay on the asphalt. Entry gate clearance 14 ft 2 in.

values.note: Three restroom buildings with showers; only the A/B loop restroom is open in winter. Laundry in the camper services building except in winter. Playgrounds, horseshoe pits.

note: CPW park on the west shore of Boyd Lake at the NE edge of Loveland; Cottonwood Campground sits ~100 yd back from the shore behind a treeline and the paved lake-loop path, with open reservoir views from the perimeter sites. Marina and swim beach are separate areas north of the campground. Boating is closed for the rest of 2026 for low water (hand-launched craft and swimming still allowed). --Claude
summary: CPW camping page + cpwshop site list and site details: confirmed 20/30/50-amp electric, pull-throughs, showers, dump, year-round, reservation-only on cpwshop (6 months ahead), $36-$41 + vehicle pass, phone. Changed sites.count 140 -> 200 (cpwshop lists 200 campsites; CPW's page still says 140), added max_rig_ft 60, water + sewer true (44 full-hookup sites in loop A), laundry, booking url/window/fcfs never/season, winter note. Note: corrected 'east shore' -> west shore and dropped field restatements.
flags: Site count conflict: CPW's camping page says '140 paved pull-through sites, equipped for vehicles up to 40 feet'; CPW's own booking site lists 200 campsites in loops A-F (loop A, sites 201-285, includes 44 full-hookup sites and is under revegetation 'in 2025 and 2026', which looks like a rebuilt/expanded loop the park page has not caught up with). Recorded 200 and max 60 from the booking site; 74 of the 200 are back-in, not pull-through.
Max length: booking site per-site lengths are 60 ft (all 116 loop B-F pull-throughs), 55 ft (9) and 40 ft (73, loop A); the park page says 'vehicles up to 40 feet'. Every length is above 23 ft.

Lakeview (stored) vs cpwshop 'Proximity to Water: Lakefront' tags - re-audit lead, waterfront not changed: CPW tags the perimeter sites at the south/east end of loops B-F as Lakefront (054, 082, 103, 124, 145 in the sample). On imagery those sites are ~75-150 m from the treeline and paved path along Boyd Lake's shore (lake to the east/southeast, water now well drawn down below a wide sand beach). An operator water claim that differs from ours triggers the gate.
Note correction: the stored note put the park on Boyd Lake's 'east shore'; on imagery the campground has the lake to its east, i.e. it is on the west shore (corrected in the note).
Pin 40.4307,-105.0427 is ~190 m NW of the centroid of 29 sampled site points (40.42914,-105.04170), at the campground entrance road between loops A and B-F. OK.

Status (not a closure): 'Due to low water levels, Boyd Lake is closed to boating for the rest of 2026. Hand-launched vessels - such as kayaks & paddleboards - & swimming are still allowed.' Camping unaffected. Loop A: tents only on pads during revegetation in 2025-2026.
Reservation fee: CPW's per-stay reservation fee is not stated on the Boyd Lake pages read; not recorded.
